number_format: Inputs are binary64: 'binary64' is the shortest round-trip decimal, 'hex' the exact hex form, 'exact' the exact rational. Derived reals are decimal strings ('value', 40 significant digits) with the nearest binary64; 'exact' on a derived quantity is an exact rational. Deviations and cross-check residuals are short diagnostics, not references. SI units.
item: 3. Two-mass lumped chain (AC-002: MDOF modal responses and each modal combination, CQC on a closely spaced pair with opposite-sign contributions, the rigid response with an extracted rigid mode, and a stiff model equal to the static response)
sign_conventions: u positive along the excitation axis away from the ground; spring forces tension positive; ground reaction is K_cf u, the force the support applies to the chain
rules_not_in_scope: ABSSUM_not_in_scope and PAIRWISE10_not_in_scope are not in the scope today; published for comparison only

A.purpose: well separated modes (5.03 Hz, 9.75 Hz); exact rational eigenvalues 1000 and 3750; missing mass with f_r between the modes (mode 2 rigid) and above both

disclosure.missing_mass_fraction: 0 (the two modes are the whole finite spectrum)

B.purpose: closely spaced pair (frequency ratio 1.065, within 10 %): contributions of opposite sign to the spring 2 force (CQC below SRSS) and of the same sign to u1 and the ground reaction (CQC above SRSS)

disclosure.missing_mass_fraction: 0 (the two modes are the whole finite spectrum)

C.purpose: stiff chain (159 Hz, 308 Hz, above T1's range): with f_r = 50 Hz every mode is rigid and the response equals the static response to the rigid acceleration; without the correction the request is refused (periodic modes outside the tabulated range)

without_missing_mass.expected: refused: periodic modes outside the tabulated range of T1 (no extrapolation)

cross_checks.what: shape from the second row against the first row
per-mode ground reaction per unit spectral acceleration against minus the effective mass
sum of effective masses against the total mass
lam1 lam2 = c/a and lam1 + lam2 = b/a
static rigid solve against the rigid modes' signed contributions a_r Gamma phi / w^2
rigid ground reaction against minus the total static load
stiff case against the hand static solution
spring 2 force: contributions of opposite sign and CQC < SRSS
u1_m: contributions of the same sign and CQC > SRSS
ground_reaction_N: contributions of the same sign and CQC > SRSS
